about: Brandon L. Peak is a partner with Peak Wooten McDaniel & Colwell LLP. A top-ranked attorney, Mr. Peak focuses his practice primarily on personal injury law, and he provides exceptional counsel, advocacy and support to clients across his region and throughout the country who have suffered serious injuries or lost a loved one due to someone else's negligence or wrongdoing.

Over the course of his legal career, Mr. Peak has recovered more than $1 billion dollars in total compensation for his clients, and he obtained one of the largest awards ever for a trucking accident at more than $280 million. Along with personal injury and wrongful death claims, he has extensive experience handling business torts, whistleblower cases, class actions, False Claims Act cases and more.

A 2001 graduate of The Citadel, where he was a member of the Summerall Guards and the Honor Court, Mr. Peak attended Mercer University's Walter F. George School of Law, where he served as Articles Editor of the Mercer Law Review and Chief Justice of the Honor Council as well as the Intrastate Moot Court Team. He also received the Walter Johnson, Jr. Award and the Walter F. George Medal for graduating first in his class.

A leader in his legal community, Mr. Peak has helped author the Frequently Used Statutes of the GTLA Trial Practice Manual and Trial Practice and Procedure. He is also an active member of the Chattahoochee Bar Association, the Columbus Bar Association and the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, among his other professional affiliations.
